papers.title_en: FOMI: A Force-Feedback Manipulation Interface for Teaching Contact-Rich Manipulation
papers.authors: Yishu Shen, Yiming Luo, Ruilin Wang, Bowen Yang, Shuai Yang, Fangyi Xu, Yujun Shen, Fu Zhang, Boyu Zhou, Yinghao Xu
papers.evidence: 手持力反馈界面提供直观触觉交互
papers.tldr: 手持接口可支持无需机器人的示范采集，但直观力反馈不足，使接触密集型操作难以高效示教。FOMI采用剪刀式机构，无需力传感器即可通过传动连杆将物体交互力直接传至人手，并集成标定、数据采集与同步，支持离线示范采集和机器人遥操作。在四项接触密集型任务中，两种模式的采集效率较各自最佳基线分别提升约29%和18%。两类示范均能训练出高成功率策略，为接触密集型操作的数据采集提供有效接口。
papers.abstract_en: Robot-free collection with handheld interfaces enables scalable acquisition of human demonstrations for policy learning. However, existing handheld interfaces often provide limited intuitive force feedback, making contact-rich demonstration collection challenging for human operators. To address this, we present FOMI, a force-feedback manipulation interface with a scissor-shaped mechanism, which transmits object interaction forces directly to the operator's hands through actuation links without force sensors. This intuitive force feedback supports real-time action adjustment during robot-free collection of contact-rich demonstrations. Around FOMI, we build a demonstration collection system that integrates sensor calibration, data acquisition, and synchronization for robot-free collection. By further mapping pose changes and gripper opening of FOMI to robot end-effector poses and gripper commands, the system also supports teleoperation. Across four contact-rich tasks, FOMI improves collection efficiency by approximately 29% and 18% over the best baselines in robot-free collection and teleoperation, respectively. Demonstrations collected with FOMI in both modes enable policies to perform challenging contact-rich manipulation tasks with high success rates.

papers.title_en: JaxMARL-BC: Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for Macroeconomic Modelling, in Seconds
papers.authors: Daniele Montagnani, Andrea Coletta, Antonietta Mira, Aldo Glielmo
papers.evidence: 提出用于宏观经济建模的多智能体强化学习框架
papers.tldr: 多智能体强化学习可为宏观经济模拟引入异质决策者，但漫长训练阻碍了应用。论文提出基于JAX加速的JaxMARL-BC，沿用在特定极限下可还原经典DSGE模型的经济框架。相较参考实现，训练加速75至724倍，可扩展至20万独立学习家庭，并通过已知DSGE极限验证正确性。异质资本回报模型的概念验证校准仅需两小时，而原先需一个多月；开源实现为大规模异质经济研究降低了计算门槛。
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) offers a principled way of populating simulated economies with many heterogeneous decision makers. Its adoption, pioneered in finance, has nonetheless been slow in macroeconomics because of two main limitations: the lack of a shared frame of reference connecting MARL systems to dynamic stochastic general equilibrium (DSGE) models the profession already trusts, and the very long training times. The first limitation was recently addressed by the Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning Business Cycle (MARL-BC), which places deep RL households in a real business cycle economy and reduces to classic DSGE models in specific limits. Here we address the second limitation. We present JaxMARL-BC, a JAX-accelerated simulator that trains MARL-BC economies in seconds (between 75x and 724x faster than the reference implementation), and scales to 200,000 independent learning households. We verify its correctness against the known DSGE limits, characterise its scaling through a simple cost law, and demonstrate its value by a proof-of-concept calibration of an extended model with heterogeneous returns on capital, in a two-hour experiment that would previously have taken over a month. We release JaxMARL-BC as open source.

papers.title_en: Scriptorium: System Design and Implementation of a Multi-Human, Multi-AI Collaborative Digital Library Search Platform
papers.authors: Abbas Pirmoradi, Milad Momeni, Anna Chu, Orland Hoeber
papers.evidence: 设计供人类与分工人工智能智能体协同使用的搜索界面。
papers.tldr: 协作式学术检索需要共享搜索过程，现有生成式人工智能工作空间却多面向个人。该报告介绍数字图书馆平台Scriptorium，将跨用户搜索活动透明化与七个角色专门化智能体的管理者—工作者架构结合。报告公开系统架构、数据模型、智能体提示词、确定性护栏及运行配置，支持复现与扩展。当前成果是系统设计与实现，尚未验证检索收益；作者计划通过用户研究，检验透明协作与分工式智能辅助能否促进不同研究线索之间的意外交叉启发。
papers.abstract_en: This technical report documents the design and implementation of Scriptorium, a digital library search interface designed to support multi-human, multi-AI collaboration: full cross-user transparency of search activity combined with a Manager--Worker architecture of seven role-specialized generative AI agents. A companion short demonstration paper describes Scriptorium's interaction design; because a demonstration format is constrained to a few pages, it necessarily omits most implementation detail. This report documents Scriptorium's complete system architecture, data model, collaborative-interaction design rationale, and AI orchestration mechanism, including verbatim agent prompts, the deterministic guardrails that constrain them, the language model and retrieval configuration, and the steps needed to run the system, so that the design can be inspected, critiqued, reproduced, and reused by other researchers. We also discuss the system's current limitations and the user study we are planning to evaluate its central hypothesis: that combining collaborative transparency with scoped multi-agent AI assistance increases serendipitous cross-pollination between collaborators' research threads.

papers.title_en: Situating Vulnerability: An Ethical Governance Framework for Anthropomorphic AI Interaction
papers.authors: Hanhui Xu, Jiacheng Ji, Yuhan Wang, Haoan Jin, Jaiming Luo, Mengyue Wu
papers.evidence: 探讨拟人化情感交互对脆弱用户的风险
papers.tldr: 大语言模型通过记忆、情感表达和持续陪伴形成拟人化关系，同一句共情回应可能安慰用户，也可能加深依赖或妄想，单条输出指标难以捕捉这些风险。论文将脆弱性视为普遍、关系性且存在差异的状态，主张以具体脆弱情境而非固定人群作为治理单位。框架区分身体、情绪、认知、自主性和关系五类情境，并将七项原则细化为回应校准要求。其贡献是避免诊断和持久标签化用户，推动安全治理从输出控制转向关系安全。
papers.abstract_en: Large language models increasingly address users in the register of care: they remember personal details, adopt a first-person emotional voice, and sustain relationships across many sessions. This anthropomorphic mode of interaction generates risks that output-level metrics capture poorly, because the same empathic utterance may console one user, entrap a second, and consolidate a delusion in a third. Governance has responded in two ways. Uniform restriction refuses sensitive requests or suppresses empathic phrasing across all outputs; group-targeted protection profiles vulnerable populations and applies stricter or prohibitive rules to them. This article argues that both fail. Uniform restriction mislocates harm in the lexical form of responses rather than in the trajectory of a relationship; group-based protection depends on a list that can never be complete, treats a fluid property as a static attribute of persons, and converts protective attention into stigmatizing labels. Drawing on philosophical work that treats vulnerability as universal, relational, and differentiated, we propose that the unit of ethical governance should be the vulnerability situation rather than the vulnerable group, develop a typology of five situations - physical, emotional, cognitive, autonomy, and relational - and specify seven principles into requirements that guide response calibration without diagnosing or persistently classifying users. The framework relocates AI safety from output control to relational safety.

papers.title_en: Privacy Preference Controls for Agentic Systems
papers.authors: Shreya Kochar, Peeranat Sugsavanvit, Vidur Gupta, Joseph A. Calandrino, Deepak Kumar, Brett Frischmann, Sebastian Zimmeck
papers.evidence: 为代表用户行动的智能体设计可执行隐私偏好控制
papers.tldr: 人工智能代理正从辅助用户操作转向自主执行任务，现有隐私偏好工具难以直接适配这一变化。论文结合法律、既有隐私工具的实证研究及对30个主流人工智能助手与代理平台的审计，构建可强制执行的隐私偏好分类体系。作者开发了8个贴近真实应用的开源原型，展示如何将主要偏好控制机制整合进MCP与Agent2Agent等协议。研究为代理系统的隐私控制提供分类与实现基础，旨在保护用户隐私和自主权。
papers.abstract_en: In response to vast and widespread online tracking, regulators and technologists alike have worked to develop laws and tools that allow people to express their privacy preferences. These measures seek to offer users greater control over the sale and sharing of personal information, putting agency in their hands to protect their privacy. However, the web is undergoing a seismic shift, away from strictly \textit{user-driven} behavior towards \textit{agentic behavior}, where AI agents take autonomous actions on behalf of users. In this study, we ask: What should privacy preference controls look like in the agentic web and agentic systems more generally? To answer this question, we develop a taxonomy of enforceable privacy preferences for agentic systems. Our taxonomy is informed both by laws and empirical studies of existing privacy tools as well as an audit of 30 leading AI assistants and agent platforms. To explore how our taxonomy can be implemented, we design and develop eight open-source prototypes that mirror real-world agentic applications and demonstrate how major aspects of our taxonomy can be structurally integrated in agentic protocols, such as the Model Control Protocol and Agent2Agent protocol. Ultimately, our study seeks to provide the groundwork for ensuring end-user privacy and autonomy is not lost in the newly arriving agentic world.

papers.title_en: VEILED-SH: Vulnerability Expression through Indirect Language Evaluation Dataset (Self-Harm)
papers.authors: Leanne Tan, Keith Chua, Shaun Khoo, Onno P. Kampman, Lim Ruling Charmaine, Hazirah Hoosainsah, Kellie Yu Hui Sim, Kai He, Kenny Tsu Wei Choo, Roy Ka-Wei Lee
papers.evidence: 评估人工智能对间接自伤与痛苦表达的回应
papers.tldr: 人工智能可能漏识文化语境中的间接自杀、自伤与痛苦表达，也可能给出不适合应用场景的支持。VEILED-SH收录10,003条提示，覆盖咨询聊天、论坛发帖、平台搜索与分诊，并以多标签体系区分意图、交际功能和回应行为。研究分别校准六个自动化评估档案，保留不同从业者的参考策略；对五个系统的评测显示，同一回答在不同策略下的代理对齐表现存在差异。该基准将文化差异、场景需求与专业判断分歧纳入评估。
papers.abstract_en: AI systems may miss indirect, culturally situated distress or provide support mismatched to the application context. Existing benchmarks do not jointly address cultural variation, application context, and practitioner disagreement. We introduce VEILED-SH, a benchmark and construction methodology for evaluating single-turn responses to indirect expressions of suicide, self-harm, and distress. Its 10,003 prompts span counselor chat, forum posts, platform search, and triage, drawing on Singapore-grounded sources and public datasets. An expert-validated multi-label taxonomy distinguishes intent, communicative function, and response behavior. Six automated profiles, individually calibrated to three peer-support practitioners and three clinicians, retain separate reference policies for proxy-alignment scoring. Evaluating five systems on a coverage-enriched sample reveals variation in proxy alignment across profile-generated reference policies, even for the same system responses.

papers.title_en: Training-Free Continual Learning for Multimodal Forecasting via Prompt Evolution
papers.authors: Laurent Mombaerts, Jonathan Taws, Jacopo Gargano, Dinesh Gaddam, Kevin George, Srijan Tiwari, Shreyas Rajesh
papers.evidence: 以大语言模型预测货币、商品及搜索指数等经济金融时间序列。
papers.tldr: 面对时间序列的持续分布变化，本文探索不重训模型、仅更新提示文本的适应方式。方法冻结预测模型，通过预测结果驱动的反思演化约900词指导，并控制模型知识截止时间以降低数据泄漏风险。在搜索指数、汇率和商品基准上，指导后的模型误差低于时间序列基础模型，更新仅需数美元。但优化环内收益会高估泛化收益，移除新闻也未损害预测表现。这为低成本持续适应提供了路径，同时揭示独立监测与多模态目标设计的重要性。
papers.abstract_en: Adapting a forecasting system to a changing world classically means retraining. We ask whether the task of continually learning regimes for time series forecasting can be represented by a piece of text: a guidance block, evolved by outcome-driven reflection and used in a frozen LLM forecaster's prompt. On a refreshed multimodal benchmark (weekly search indices, daily currencies, daily commodities, each window paired with web-retrieved news), we run GEPA-style prompt evolution under strict contamination control to prevent the data leakage common in timeseries benchmarks: the forecaster's knowledge cutoff predates every evaluated window. A 900-word evolved guidance carried by Llama-3.3-70B beats TimeSeries Foundation Models (TSFMs) on held-out data (GM MASE 0.776 vs. 0.898 for TabPFN-TS-3), transfers to more recent models without measurable loss, and costs dollars rather than GPU-days to update. We characterize the loop: out-of-loop gains concentrate in the first reflection, in-loop improvements overstate out-of-loop gains 2-3x unless an untouched monitor arbitrates, and error-only objectives silently suppress the text modality. We provide two extensions. First, compiling the guidance into executable code with a TSFM as a callable tool recovers most of the gain deterministically. Second, ablations show the advantage widens at short horizons and that removing the news text does not hurt the guided forecaster, consistent with the text's value being distilled into policy during learning. We argue that continual prompt evolution is a practical, training-free alternative to retraining for multimodal forecasting.

papers.title_en: S$^2$-MAS: A Society-Scale Multi-Agent Simulation Framework with 500 Million Household Persona Agents
papers.authors: Yang Li, Di Wan, Yike Wang, Chujun He, Zongsi Xu, Xiyu Chen, Sheng Zhong, Deng Binjie, Zhenwei Guo, Hou Jun, Kunhan Guo, Weihao Lin, Tuo Zhou, Hai Liu, Ye Luo
papers.evidence: 以真实调查数据为基础，用合成角色智能体模拟大规模家庭经济决策
papers.tldr: 社会规模经济模拟需要同时刻画家庭差异与决策的长期后果。S²-MAS基于真实调查构建5亿个合成家庭画像，将决策与状态更新分离，并用账本追踪消费、现金及债务。其轻量决策模型准确率达74.55%；1200万家庭的配对模拟显示，同时提高购买目标与授信额度会增加消费，但群体响应不同。框架还支持24个月动态模拟，为跨家庭群体、人口规模和时间跨度的经济实验提供工具。
papers.abstract_en: Simulating economic responses at society scale requires agents whose decisions reflect household circumstances and the effects of earlier actions. We introduce S$^2$-MAS, a society-scale multi-agent simulation framework built on 500 million synthetic household personas grounded in real-survey data. Its Genese engine separates decisions from state updates, while reusable financial scenarios and application ledgers track consumption, cash, debt and payments. Sharp-421m-mlx, a compact decision model trained with SFT + RLCD on 2.93 million examples, achieves 74.55% accuracy and 38.37% question-macro F1 in consumer financial-choice scenarios, outperforming Jev 1.13 and GLM-5.3-Flash on both measures. We evaluate eight financial task families and simulate 12 million distinct household agents in paired purchase-funding conditions. Jointly raising purchase goals and approved credit limits increases consumption, with responses differing across age and income groups. Education, employment and household-size differences persist after age--income standardization and mainly reflect transitions from deferral to purchase. Asset and debt groups differ in cash drawdown, repayment and closing debt. A 24-month panel varies purchase goals under a common credit product, with repayment and arrears updating subsequent offers. S$^2$-MAS links heterogeneous household decisions to evolving consumption, cash and repayment paths, supporting economic experiments across household groups, population scales and time horizons.

papers.title_en: LiveUIBench: Evaluating Agent as App Workflows
papers.authors: Tong Zhang, Yuxuan Cheng, Ruimin Zhang, Yun Peng, Tao Xie
papers.evidence: 代理依据用户自然语言需求创建并运行个性化应用
papers.tldr: 个性化应用需要适应用户差异与持续变化的需求，传统生成应用的方式往往需要修改实现。论文提出“智能体即应用”，由智能体创建界面，并在使用期间持续负责行为执行，通过任务编排连接界面、已存信息与服务操作。作者实现了LiveUIAgent，并构建覆盖多样需求与有序交互的LiveUIBench；评测发现，局部检查通过不代表完整工作流成功，部分覆盖更高时，完成率反而可能更低。这为持续个性化应用提供了实现路径与端到端评测基准。
papers.abstract_en: Applications provide convenient features for users to complete daily tasks. However, different users may have different or even conflicting requirements for the same application, while the requirements of the same user may change over time. Personalizing applications produced by agent-to-app or UI-to-code approaches can require changes to the generated implementation. We propose Agent as App, a task in which users express their requirements in natural language and an agent creates a personalized application while continuing to supply its behavior during use. We implement LiveUIAgent, which generates a task-specific orchestration connecting the user interface, saved information, and service actions. A shared agent runtime renders and updates the interface while carrying out the requested operations. Revising the orchestration and interface while reusing that runtime provides a lightweight basis for personalization as requirements evolve. We introduce LiveUIBench, a benchmark with diverse requirements and ordered interactions across personal services. The empirical findings show that the evaluated models struggle to complete these workflows reliably. Applications can satisfy many local checks while leaving the overall task unfinished, and greater partial coverage can coincide with fewer completed workflows.

papers.title_en: DIVE: Benchmarking Full-Duplex Interaction with Visual Engagement in Continuous Streams
papers.authors: Yuhang Chen, Guangyue Liu, Shilong Liu
papers.evidence: 提出评估连续全双工多模态交互的基准
papers.tldr: 现有流式多模态评测主要关注带时间戳的问答，难以衡量模型在连续交互中是否、何时及如何回应。DIVE以525段音视频样本构建六项任务，覆盖主动干预、持续参与和交互协调，并分别评估回答质量、参与决策与响应时机。实验发现，领先实时模型虽能实现亚秒级平均响应，但平均窗口响应率仍不超过53.77%，且难以根据新信息调整正在生成的回答。该基准将评测重点从感知准确性拓展到持续交互能力。
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have substantially improved spoken interaction and video understanding. Existing online and streaming benchmarks primarily assess causal multimodal perception through timestamped question answering, whereas real-world interaction requires models to continuously identify task-relevant multimodal cues and decide whether, when, and how to respond. This leaves open how well current models can sustain real-time interaction throughout an evolving multimodal stream. To address this gap, we introduce DIVE, a benchmark for evaluating full-duplex interaction with visual engagement under continuous and realistic multimodal streams. It organizes six tasks into three complementary interaction scenarios. (1) Proactive Intervention evaluates whether models can identify emerging visual or semantic cues and intervene at the appropriate moment. (2) Continuous Engagement evaluates sustained participation through continuous visual tracking and visually grounded query interaction. (3) Interaction Coordination evaluates how models coordinate listening and speaking under overlapping and multi-party interactions. DIVE contains 525 audio/video samples with fine-grained human annotations and precise temporal metadata. Its evaluation protocol separates response quality, participation decisions, and response timing. We evaluate representative real-time models using response quality, window response rates, and reaction latency. Experiments show that leading real-time models achieve sub-second average response latency, yet their average window response rates remain at or below 53.77%. Response quality varies substantially across models and tasks, with adapting ongoing responses to newly arriving information remaining particularly challenging. We hope DIVE facilitates progress toward more natural and capable real-time multimodal interactive systems.

papers.title_en: Scaling Therapy Supervision: Assessing Psychotherapy Fidelity Using Large Language Models
papers.authors: Arvind Pillai, Alexis Roach, Jason Holden, Varsha D Badal, Subigya Nepal, Yu Yvonne Wu, Yuliang Chen, Sudarshan Regmi, Sarah Masud Preum, Nicholas C Jacobson, Nikhil Singh, Eric Granholm, Colin Depp, Andrew Campbell
papers.evidence: 利用大语言模型评估心理治疗忠实度并生成督导反馈
papers.tldr: 心理治疗忠实度评估依赖专家人工审阅，耗时且难以规模化，限制了临床督导与治疗师自学。研究利用大语言模型分析真实长篇临床转录，自动生成忠实度评分和可操作的督导反馈，并比较三种开放权重模型的任务分解与推理策略。结果表明，证据优先推理改善评估表现，系统在独立随机对照试验中能区分认知行为治疗与非此类治疗，专家也认可反馈的可操作性。该方法为扩大心理治疗督导覆盖提供了可扩展路径。
papers.abstract_en: Psychotherapy fidelity assessment measures how faithfully a therapist adheres to a treatment protocol, a critical determinant of positive patient outcomes. However, fidelity assessment is bottlenecked by manual expert review, rendering the process labor-intensive and unscalable. To scale therapy supervision and support clinician self-learning, we present an integrated application of large language models (LLMs) that automates psychotherapy fidelity workflows and generates actionable supervisory feedback from authentic, long-form clinical transcripts. We evaluate three open-weight models across multiple task decomposition configurations and reasoning strategies, demonstrating that evidence-first reasoning improves fidelity estimation. Furthermore, we establish the framework's external construct validity on an independent randomized controlled trial (RCT), where it reliably distinguishes Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT) from non-CBT sessions across core therapeutic skills. Through a user study that evaluates the generated feedback, mental health experts indicate that the pipeline synthesizes actionable clinical feedback. Ultimately, our work offers a practical, scalable solution toward bridging the community mental health supervision gap.

papers.title_en: MA-UITD: Offline Multi-Agent Reward Inference for Characterizing Continuous Social Behavior
papers.authors: Zeyuan Zhang, Yiyun Yang, Yuan Cheng, Herbert Zheng Wu, Yusi Chen
papers.evidence: 从多智能体互动行为中离线推断个体奖励
papers.tldr: 多智能体行为同时受自身偏好与对他人的预期影响，使固定轨迹中的奖励推断面临困难。MA-UITD以信念条件化后继特征表征自身动作的长期影响，结合逆时序差分一致性与噪声对比学习，离线推断个体奖励，无需已知动力学或内层策略优化。模拟中，离散动作任务优于基线，连续动作任务获得与行为相容的奖励；真实社会觅食数据揭示领随者不同的空间及交互奖励结构。该方法为量化社会行为目标和研究相关神经计算提供工具。
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent inverse reinforcement learning offers a powerful framework not only for imitation learning but also for understanding the neural computations supporting social interactions and decision-making. Inferring rewards from interacting agents is challenging because observed choices reflect both personal preferences and expectations about others. Existing methods often require additional environment interaction, repeated policy optimization as an inner loop, or restrictive assumptions about environment dynamics and action spaces, limiting their applicability to fixed behavioral datasets. We introduce Multi-Agent Unilateral Inverse Temporal Difference Learning (MA-UITD), an offline method for inferring explicit agent-specific rewards from joint demonstrations in continuous-state environments with either discrete or bounded continuous actions. Its core idea is to represent the long-term consequences of each agent's own actions through belief-conditioned successor features that average over other agents' behavior. Shared reward features and agent-specific preference vectors connect these unilateral values to the target reward function, while inverse temporal-difference consistency and noise-contrastive behavioral learning enable inference without known dynamics or an inner policy-optimization loop. Across simulated cooperative, competitive, and general-sum tasks, MA-UITD outperforms baselines in discrete-action settings and infers behaviorally compatible reward profiles in continuous-action settings. When applied to experimentally collected social-foraging trajectories, MA-UITD inferred distinct spatial and interaction-dependent reward structures for leaders and followers, providing a quantitative characterization of latent behavioral objectives that may be relevant for understanding the neural computations underlying social behavior.

papers.title_en: Beyond Small Talk: Modeling Disclosure Trajectories in Human-AI Conversation
papers.authors: Keith Kwok, Wanting Ning, Tej Deep Pala, Desmond C. Ong, S. Supraja, Renwen Zhang, Soujanya Poria
papers.evidence: 评估提供社会与情感支持的对话代理如何回应逐步披露
papers.tldr: 情感支持对话中的自我披露会随时间变化，但孤立轮次评估难以识别历史影响。论文提出基于社会渗透理论的TraDE框架，通过预设披露轨迹，在当前披露深度一致时比较模型行为。多模型结果显示，历史会改变模型接受或质疑用户叙事的倾向，且影响主要随深度披露的累积暴露变化，退回浅层后仍持续数轮。模型与人类支持者的差异尤其出现在用户减少披露时，说明评估需要关注完整披露轨迹。
papers.abstract_en: Recently, we see a rise in conversational agents as a form of social and emotional support, where disclosure will unfold over time. Yet, current evaluations of these agents typically examine isolated conversational states. In analyses of naturally occurring conversations, disclosure history and current disclosure are confounded which tends to make their effects difficult to isolate. We thus introduce Trajectory-based Disclosure Evaluation (TraDE), an evaluation framework grounded in Social Penetration Theory that utilizes predefined disclosure trajectories and evaluates how preceding disclosure history shapes model behavior under matched current disclosure. Through the use of TraDE, we demonstrate across multiple models and relational behavior benchmarks that responses to disclosures matched on depth can differ depending on the preceding trajectory, particularly in whether models accept or challenge the user's framing. We also observed that these differences track accumulated exposure to deeper disclosure rather than any single moment of vulnerability or the order of disclosures. It also tends to persists for several turns after disclosure returns to shallow levels. For several behaviors, we also demonstrate that models diverge most consistently from human supporters in the Emotional Support Conversation corpus (ESConv) not when users open up but rather when they step back in their disclosure. TraDE thus provides a systematic way to expose history-dependent relational behavior that evaluations of isolated conversational states would otherwise miss.

papers.title_en: UserSWE: Evaluating Coding Agents in Multi-Turn Conversations with Dynamic Users
papers.authors: Zhan-Yu Wu, Ji Luo, Alyssa Wu, Junjielong Xu, Richeng Xuan, Zhichao Hu, Chongming Gao, Xinting Hu
papers.evidence: 评测编码智能体与动态用户的多轮交互能力
papers.tldr: 现有代码智能体基准多在单轮中提供完整问题，难以衡量真实多轮调试能力，且可能误判补丁。UserSWE以信息池限制用户可透露的内容，并模拟逐轮变化的用户风格；每轮运行测试，由跨模型家族的双智能体生成并审核判定。在42个仓库的72项任务上评估11个智能体，发现领先模型随交互轮数变化，单轮与八轮的最优模型不同。这表明交互预算会影响能力排名，代码智能体评估应同时考虑动态用户与执行证据。
papers.abstract_en: As coding agents become more capable, developers increasingly use them to fix bugs through multi-turn interactions. Existing benchmarks do not adequately cover this scenario. Most present a complete issue report in a single turn without interaction. Their evaluation can produce both false positives and false negatives, accepting incorrect patches or rejecting correct ones. We introduce UserSWE for evaluating coding agents' ability to fix repository-level bugs through multi-turn interactions with dynamic users and execution-grounded verdicts at every turn. Its construction pipeline turns repository history and existing single-turn benchmarks into multi-turn tasks. At each turn, information pools constrain what the simulated user can reveal, while a persona chain sampled from a transition model calibrated on 20,859 development sessions governs how it speaks. Tests run after every turn, and a pair of agents from different model families writes and gates each verdict, using test results as primary evidence and model judgment only for aspects the tests cannot resolve. We evaluate eleven agents on 72 tasks from 42 repositories and find that agent rankings change with the interaction budget. Claude Fable 5.1 resolves the most tasks in one turn, GPT-6-Astra resolves the most by the eighth turn, and Claude Opus 5 leads at most intermediate budgets. These results indicate that single-turn performance is insufficient to characterize interactive coding ability.

papers.title_en: From Content Sharing to Opinion Shaping: A Theoretical Framework for Cascade-Driven Opinion Dynamics
papers.authors: Elisabetta Biondi, Chiara Boldrini, Andrea Passarella, Marco Conti
papers.evidence: 建模社交网络信息传播与观点变化的联动过程。
papers.tldr: 在线社交网络中的内容传播与观点形成紧密耦合，现有模型却常将二者分开处理。本文基于级联上的Friedkin–Johnsen模型，推导精确的条件逐层递推，并以均场解耦近似和树结构约简降低分析与计算难度。随机块模型网络上的仿真表明，级联驱动的观点演化可产生有限同化与持续极化，而非仅趋向整体同质化。研究为联合分析随机传播和社会影响提供理论基础，并揭示忽略二者统计耦合可能带来的局限。
papers.abstract_en: Online social networks (OSNs) tightly couple information diffusion and opinion formation, yet most existing models treat these processes separately. Building on the Friedkin-Johnsen on Cascades (FJC) model, which integrates opinion updating within stochastic information cascades, we advance its analytical characterization and systematic validation. We derive an exact conditional layer-wise recursion that reveals the statistical coupling between diffusion realizations and opinion evolution, showing that a closed-form recursion in unconditional expectations is not available. To overcome this limitation, we introduce a mean-field decoupling approximation (MFA) that yields a tractable linear recursion for the expected opinion trajectory. We also develop scalable tree-based reductions that drastically reduce computational complexity while preserving structural diffusion properties, and validate the analytical recursion and its approximations through extensive simulations. Using Stochastic Block Model networks with controlled initial opinion configurations, we show that, unlike the classical Friedkin-Johnsen model, which typically leads to global homogenization, the FJC dynamics generate richer regimes of bounded assimilation and sustained polarization. Overall, this work bridges diffusion and influence modeling, providing a theoretical foundation for understanding how cascade-driven interactions reshape collective opinion landscapes in structured social networks.

papers.title_en: OwlSight: A Panoramic Monitor for Chain-of-Thought Reasoning
papers.authors: Lewen Yan, Yanxu Zhu, Jie Zhang, Jing Shao
papers.evidence: 提供可配置推理监控，支持人工监督与及时干预
papers.tldr: 现有思维链监控多面向特定任务，难以覆盖推理模型在能力、安全与可信性上的多维风险。OwlSight引入可在提示中定制的监控因子，以细粒度具体目标和粗粒度风险类别驱动同一监控器。基于15971条推理轨迹，两个粒度下较通用大模型分别提升1.32—30.57和11.71—27.81分，并在OpenAI思维链可监控性基准上达到最优。其对未见模型及文本变换的适应性，为跨任务监督提供了新路径。
papers.abstract_en: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) monitoring offers actionable evidence for oversight AI systems, with the potential to enable early detection and intervention. However, existing approaches are focused on specific tasks, whereas the regulation of AI, particularly reasoning models, requires monitoring a broader range of tasks. We introduce Factor for CoT monitoring, a strategy that supports customizing monitoring requirements in the prompt, which enables a single monitor to cover different tasks by relying on different factors. Furthermore, we introduce two types of factors, fine-grained and coarse-grained (e.g., monitoring whether a specific email address has been leaked versus monitoring privacy leakage), to accommodate diverse user monitoring needs. Based on this, we develop a CoT monitor named OwlSight that relies solely on factor to monitor behaviors related to multiple dimensions, including capability, safety, and trustworthiness. Experiments across 15,971 reasoning trajectories show that OwlSight surpasses general-purpose LLMs by 1.32-30.57 and 11.71-27.81 points at fine and coarse granularity, respectively, and achieves state-of-the-art results on OpenAI's CoT monitorability benchmark. It also generalizes to unseen models' CoTs and remains robust to Factor rephrasings, CoT compression, and obfuscation, offering a promising paradigm for CoT monitoring that can contribute to the oversight of frontier AI.

papers.title_en: GPT-6 Astra Is a Native Visuo-Tactile Policy for Contact-Rich Manipulation
papers.authors: Chen Yang, Linzhe Shi, Hang Zhang, Mu Xu, Jiansheng Fan, Chen Wang
papers.evidence: 融合视觉与触觉输入实现闭环机器人交互操作
papers.tldr: 接触密集型机器人操作通常依赖专用策略，通用模型能否直接利用触觉仍不明确。本文将触觉RGB图像接入GPT-6 Astra现有视觉接口，以少样本上下文学习实现视触觉闭环控制。在两个基准共19项仿真任务中，视触觉成功率达93.8%和81.8%，分别领先最强对比基线22.9和13.1个百分点。结果表明通用模型可利用接触线索，精细视觉也能部分补偿触觉缺失，但仍需更难评测与实体机器人验证。
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in multimodal models have enabled GPT-6 Astra to perform robotic manipulation through in-context learning. Yet contact-rich control and tactile perception are often regarded as strengths of specialist policies, leaving open whether Astra can directly understand and use tactile observations. We provide, to our knowledge, the first demonstration that Astra directly interprets vision-based tactile images and uses their contact cues for manipulation. Tactile RGB images enter through its existing visual interface, enabling few-shot closed-loop control on nineteen simulated UniVTAC and OpenViTac tasks with 210 sampled scene seeds per setting. With visuo-tactile input, Astra achieves mean success rates of 93.8% and 81.8%, exceeding the strongest reported specialist baselines in our comparison by 22.9 and 13.1 percentage points, respectively. Vision-only performance also leads these baselines, reaching 76.3% and 80.6%. Trajectory analysis reveals active probing, cautious grasping, contact-guided alignment, and recovery, alongside difficulties with tangential loading and corrective execution. Our findings challenge the exclusivity of specialist policies in contact-rich manipulation and show that fine-grained vision can partially compensate for missing touch. They also identify vision-based tactile sensing as an interface for scaling contact understanding with foundation models and reveal signs of benchmark saturation. These results motivate joint visual-tactile pretraining, harder contact-rich evaluations, and physical-robot validation.

papers.title_en: CoopUQ: Robust Multi-Robot Social Navigation via Uncertainty-Aware Cooperative Forecasting
papers.authors: Zehao Wang, Jianpeng Yao, Yuping Wang, Yiping Li, Jiaqi Li, Zhixu Li, Kanghoon Lee, Jinfeng Wang, Cong Liu, Zhaowei Tan, Jinkyoo Park, Jiachen Li
papers.evidence: 通过多机器人协作预测与决策实现社会导航。
papers.tldr: 多机器人在人机共享空间导航时，遮挡与分布外场景会导致风险漏判，直接沿用单机器人策略难以兼顾安全与效率。CoopUQ融合跨机器人的时空特征，预测未来占据栅格及其不确定性，并通过约束多智能体强化学习惩罚穿越预测占据或高不确定区域。多种布局、人群密度及行人急行条件下的仿真表明，其预测表现和安全性优于代表性基线，实机实验进一步验证了鲁棒性。该框架将协作感知预测与风险敏感决策相连接。
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning enables mobile robots to make fast and scalable navigation decisions in constrained human-shared environments. However, directly extending single-robot approaches to multi-robot settings often fails to ensure safety and efficiency, especially under occlusions and out-of-distribution (OOD) scenarios, where individual robots may overlook potential risks or make inaccurate predictions. Leveraging cooperation effectively for both prediction and navigation remains a major challenge. We propose CoopUQ, a multi-robot social navigation framework that bridges uncertainty-aware cooperative occupancy forecasting and robust decision making. CoopUQ predicts future occupancy grid maps through cross-robot spatiotemporal feature fusion and further leverages forecasts and their uncertainty to guide policy via constrained multi-agent reinforcement learning, where the cost penalizes navigation through regions predicted to be occupied or highly uncertain. This design enables the policy to adapt its risk sensitivity under distribution shifts. Experimental results across multiple Unity3D-based simulation environments with both in-distribution and OOD settings, including diverse layouts, pedestrian densities, and rushing behavior, demonstrate improved prediction performance and safety over representative baselines. Real-robot experiments further demonstrate its robustness across various scenes. Our code and videos are available at https://coopuq.github.io/.

papers.title_en: Evolving Self-tuning Benchmarks for Long-Horizon Tool Use
papers.authors: Hyunji Alex Nam, Michael Dennis, Natasha Jaques, Minsuk Chang
papers.evidence: 聚焦人工智能助手在邮件、支付及工作软件中的长时程工具使用。
papers.tldr: 现有工具使用基准依赖人工设计或局限于特定领域，难以规模化评估长程任务。TURTLE采用无监督环境设计，通过任务提议者、求解者和反馈生成者重组并演化现有任务，依据实际求解表现寻找困难但可解的测试。在三个基准上，演化任务提升了推理与工具交互的多样性，其中AppWorld困难任务占比相对增加165%。该方法让测试集随求解能力自适应调整，并揭示更广泛的失败模式。
papers.abstract_en: For AI assistants to move beyond simple chat interfaces and reliably assist users with applications like Gmail, Venmo, and Slack, we need to improve their tool-use capabilities. However, existing tool use benchmarks are still limited and difficult to scale because they rely on human supervision or are too domain-specific. To make data generation scalable, we propose, TURTLE (Tool Use Related Tasks with Long-Horizon Evolution), an Unsupervised Environment Design (UED) approach to evolve existing tasks using a proposer, a solver, and a feedback generator large language model agents. The proposer is rewarded for difficult yet solvable tasks based on the solver's empirical performance, and the feedback generator summarizes the solver's execution traces for the proposer to exploit. TURTLE produces evolving, self-tuning test suites adaptable to different environment requirements, from supporting user simulators and dense document retrieval to interacting across multiple apps. Empirical results on AppWorld, $τ$-Bench, and AutomationBench using Gemma 4 31B-it show that the evolved tasks target the desired difficulty range (e.g., a 165% increase in the percentage of hard tasks on AppWorld), increase task diversity (in terms of reasoning and simultaneous tool interactions), and elicit a broader range of failure modes than the original tasks.

papers.title_en: An Evidence-Driven Multi-Agent Compound AI System for Head and Neck Proton Radiotherapy Planning
papers.authors: Qingqing Wang, Liqiang Xiao, Chang Chang
papers.evidence: 结合自动化规划与依据医生偏好的对话式方案修订
papers.tldr: 头颈癌质子放疗规划需兼顾临床约束与医生偏好，单一目标的改善可能损害其他目标。研究先用PPO自动生成多个候选计划，再由多智能体系统通过自然语言指令细化，并以既有计划作为调整依据。经SFT与GRPO后训练的Qwen3-14B在21例患者、每例5个计划及其中50个计划的细化任务中，相较基础模型更好地遵循指令、检索信息并权衡目标。该系统为个性化质子笔形束扫描放疗提供了证据驱动的交互式规划路径。
papers.abstract_en: Radiation treatment planning requires balancing competing objectives to satisfy clinical criteria while accommodating physicians' preferences. This study aims to develop an evidence-driven, multi-agent compound AI system that integrates DRL-based automated treatment planning with LLM-based conversational plan refinement for proton PBS therapy. A policy network trained using PPO first generates multiple plans without human intervention, from which one is selected as the target plan and the others serve as references for subsequent refinements. For challenging cases requiring further adjustments, an LLM-based multi-agent system enables plan refinement through natural language interactions. The system comprises a planning agent that recommends evidence-supported adjustments, a chatbot providing a unified conversational interface, and an evaluation agent that retrieves clinical metrics and identifies constraint violations. To enhance domain-specific reasoning, the planning agent based on Qwen3-14B is designed to justify its recommendations using evidence from previously generated plans and post-trained on task-specific data using SFT and GRPO. The framework was trained and evaluated using 21 patients with H&N cancers, with 5 PPO-generated plans per patient. Of these, 50 plans were selected for instruction-guided refinement. Compared with the base LLM, the post-trained Qwen3-14B demonstrated improved instruction-following, information retrieval and domain-specific reasoning capabilities. The resulting adjustments more effectively improved user-prioritized objectives while limiting deterioration in competing objectives, yielding more clinically appropriate trade-offs in patient-specific plan refinement. The proposed compound AI system provides a user-friendly planning platform, offering a promising approach to personalized proton PBS treatment planning.

papers.title_en: MOSAIC: An Omni-Modal Benchmark for Long-Term Memory and Cross-Modal Reasoning in Conversational Agents
papers.authors: Hong Ting Tsang, Boyi Zhang, Haoyu Huang, Jiaxin Bai, Yufei Li, Yisen Gao, Zhongwei Xie, Hongyu Luo, Jeff Z. Pan, Yangqiu Song
papers.evidence: 评测对话助手对跨模态用户历史的长期记忆与推理能力
papers.tldr: 全模态对话助手需要长期记住用户的文字、图像、视频和音频，但现有评测难以定位证据在哪个环节丢失。MOSAIC以跨越11—24次会话的历史构建923道问题，并固定问题、阅读模型、提示和预算，分别干预表示、检索与交付。结果显示，表示损失因模态而异，即使提供标准证据，阅读仍是主要瓶颈，且模型拒答能力不足。该基准将端到端排名转为写入、检索、交付和阅读四阶段诊断。
papers.abstract_en: Omni-modal assistants must remember not only what users say, but also what they show and convey. Existing long-term memory benchmarks are mostly text-and-image or report a single end-to-end score, so they cannot locate whether evidence is lost when it is represented, retrieved, delivered, or read. We introduce MOSAIC, a benchmark of 923 questions over persona-grounded histories of 11-24 sessions spanning text, image, video, and audio. MOSAIC constructs targeted spatial, temporal, and prosodic signals rather than decorative media, with the strongest causal validation for spatial information and selector-level validation for annotated prosody, and pairs them with a matched diagnostic protocol that freezes the question, reader, prompt, and budget while intervening on representation, retrieval, and delivery. Matched decomposition shows that representation loss is modality-dependent, residual reading dominates even under gold evidence, and abstention remains weak on these controls: strong answerable scores coexist with failures to refuse. MOSAIC thus turns omni-modal memory evaluation from a leaderboard into a diagnosis of write, retrieve, deliver, and read failures.

papers.title_en: Beyond Task Relevance: Interaction-Aware Semantic Communication for Wireless Agent Collaboration
papers.authors: Yiru Wang, Pengxin Guan, Xiumei Deng, Zehui Xiong
papers.evidence: 针对多智能体协作中的团队效用优化异质智能体间通信。
papers.tldr: 多智能体语义通信并非传递任务相关信息就能提升团队表现，信息共享还可能增加决策依赖、损害团队收益。论文提出交互感知框架，将通信诱发的依赖与团队最优结果的期望效用关联，在时限和功率约束下联合选择语义单元及发射功率，也允许不发送。两项可验证评分的优化任务表明，完整方案交换更易造成结构趋同与负面影响，方法提示的收益则具有方向性。该策略在所测功率预算下以更低能耗获得最高团队净收益，强调应按团队交互后果衡量通信价值。
papers.abstract_en: Semantic communication in multi-agent systems often assumes that task-relevant information benefits the team once delivered. Yet semantic sharing can alter the receiver's decision and increase inter-agent dependence, potentially reducing team utility. Motivated by this phenomenon, we develop an interaction-aware framework for wireless collaboration between heterogeneous agents. We analytically relate communication-induced dependence to expected best-of-team utility and define a team-level semantic value for candidate messages. We consider semantic units at different abstraction levels and formulate a deadline- and power-constrained problem that maximizes predicted team-level net surplus. We derive an interaction-aware policy that selects at most one unit and its transmit power, or chooses not to transmit. Experiments on two verifier-scored optimization tasks show that full-solution exchange induces stronger structural convergence and more adverse team-level effects, whereas method hints exhibit pronounced directionality. Across the evaluated power budgets, our policy achieves the highest net team-level surplus while consuming less energy than semantic-aware and full-solution baselines.

papers.title_en: Signals and Queries: Token-Efficient Agentic Context Discovery
papers.authors: Yam Marcovitz
papers.evidence: 为面向用户的智能体筛选当前交互适用的行为策略。
papers.tldr: 面向用户的智能体需逐轮判断哪些行为策略适用，但逐条调用大模型成本高，漏检又可能影响合规。S&Q离线为每条策略生成触发样例与困难负例，基于嵌入训练独立逻辑分类器，在线过滤无需调用大模型。在覆盖254个对话前缀、36条航空策略的9144个相关性标签上，该方法保持高召回并过滤至少30%的候选策略，且各测试召回水平下精确率均优于检索基线。这为降低下游策略评估开销提供了可独立更新的轻量方案。
papers.abstract_en: User-facing LLM agents must identify which behavioral policies apply at each turn, but evaluating every policy with an LLM is costly. We introduce Signals and Queries (S&Q), a lightweight first-stage relevance filter developed for Parlant 4.0 that removes at least 30% of candidate policies before downstream evaluation while preserving high recall. For each policy, an LLM generates activating examples and hard negatives offline. An independent logistic classifier trained on their embeddings then predicts relevance using embeddings and vector dot products, with no per-turn LLM calls. This shifts expensive relevance evaluation to a smaller candidate set, while allowing each policy's classifier to be updated independently. Evaluated against 9,144 LLM-judge relevance labels covering 254 $τ^2$-bench conversation prefixes and 36 airline policies, S&Q achieves higher precision than top-K and cosine-threshold retrieval at every evaluated recall level, with consistent results across two embedding providers. These findings support inexpensive, per-policy classification as a practical first stage for reducing downstream evaluation workload in customer-facing agents.

papers.title_en: Memory-Centric Continual Learning for AI Agents
papers.authors: Dongfang Li, Zhuoen Chen, Bonian Jia, Zixuan Liu, Zhengxuan Lu, Can Deng, Yukun Shi, Yuhang Meng, Xin Zhang, Jiahe Huang, Fuhao Li, Junmai Wang, Shunyao Wen, Jingjun Sun, Jiaxu Tian, Jiangling Zhang, Zihan Wang, Liangyou Li, Yitong Yao, Shuangyong Song, Beilun Wang, Pengxu Wei, Hanlin Xu, Chang Liu, Yongxiang Li, Baotian Hu, Xiangyang Ji, Min Zhang
papers.evidence: 研究智能体记忆如何支持长期经验学习与个性化
papers.tldr: 基础模型智能体受固定权重与上下文限制，难以在长期部署中持续学习，现有外部记忆又多停留于被动检索。论文提出记忆中心持续学习框架，以存储载体、记忆资产和管理策略构建分类，并通过内外双循环更新记忆与优化策略。框架以抗干扰保持、变化适应和任务迁移评估行为收益，同时分析经验、容量与计算预算的扩展关系。其贡献是将记忆评价从能否回忆转向能否改善未来行动，但摘要未报告定量实验结果。
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous agents powered by foundation models can reason, plan, and use tools, but their fixed weights and context limits hinder sustained learning from experience over long-term deployment. While external memory systems attempt to bridge this gap, they mostly act as passive retrieval caches, evaluated primarily by whether they can recall stored facts or past interactions. Whether memory can drive genuine continual learning remains an open question. In this paper, we introduce Memory-Centric Continual Learning (MCCL), arguing that memory should be judged by whether it improves future actions, not merely what it retrieves. MCCL has three main parts. First, a three-axis taxonomy organizes memory by where state is stored (substrates), what form it takes (assets), and how it is managed (policies). This defines a two-loop lifecycle that updates memory state in an inner loop while refining management policies in an outer loop based on task feedback. Second, an evaluation protocol measures retention under interference, adaptation to change, and task transfer to isolate genuine behavioral gains from simple context expansion. Third, a memory scaling framework models how agent performance scales with experience, storage capacity, and compute budgets across non-parametric and parametric memory. Together, these components reframe agent memory from passive lookup to continuous learning, offering a principled route toward self-improving autonomous agents.

papers.title_en: GRID-Planner: Graph-Structured Relational Reward Shaping for Diffusion Planning
papers.authors: Zhao Yang, Zezhong Qian, Yinan Shi, Longjun Liu, Yawei Jueluo
papers.evidence: 利用结构化关系奖励塑造多主体交互下的规划
papers.tldr: 自动驾驶规划需在复杂多车交互中兼顾安全、合规与舒适，但现有扩散与强化学习方法使用通用奖励，难以充分利用关键场景。GRID-Planner将图关系融入奖励与策略更新，结合图感知重要性加权、时序关系奖励代理及优势加权扩散训练。在nuPlan和interPlan实验中，相比纯扩散基线，碰撞率、车道偏离和加加速度分别降低35.8%、60.8%和27.4%。该框架无需显式似然，通过闭环反馈强化关键交互场景的规划学习。
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous driving planning requires selecting trajectories that remain safe, rule-compliant, and comfortable under complex multi-agent interactions, yet robust closed-loop decision making in planning-critical scenes remains challenging. Existing diffusion- and RL-based planners often rely on generic rewards and use relational structure mainly for representation, limiting how planning-critical rollouts shape policy improvement. We present GRID-Planner, a graph--reward integrated diffusion planning framework that aligns generative planning with structured relational signals. Specifically, GRID-Planner combines graph-aware importance weighting, a time-indexed relational reward surrogate, and an advantage-weighted diffusion objective with on-policy self-distillation, forming a rollout-return-advantage-update loop without explicit likelihoods. Experiments on nuPlan and interPlan show that, compared with the diffusion-only baseline, GRID-Planner reduces collision rate, lane deviation, and jerk by 35.8\%, 60.8\%, and 27.4\%, respectively, and improves the planning score by 3.4\%. Project website: https://github.com/yangzhaojason/GRID-Planner.

papers.title_en: Learning Rational Strategies for Temporal Objectives in Multi-Agent Systems
papers.authors: Omar Adalat, Edwin Hamel-De le Court, Francesco Belardinelli
papers.evidence: 研究随机多智能体系统中的稳定策略组合与均衡。
papers.tldr: 在动力学未知的随机多智能体系统中，各智能体的时序目标可能相互冲突，仅提高任务成功率不足以保证策略稳定。论文将概率有限迹时序逻辑目标编译为奖励自动机，用无模型多智能体强化学习寻找满足指定智能体概率约束、同时符合均衡要求的联合策略。研究给出表格型纳什Q学习的条件收敛保证，以有限样本置信界认证目标满足情况，并用近似最佳响应检查稳定性。在八个一般和随机博弈中开展实证验证，连接了时序规范学习与理性策略综合。
papers.abstract_en: We study rational synthesis for stochastic multi-agent systems with unknown dynamics, where each agent is equipped with its own probabilistic temporal objective specified using Probabilistic Linear Temporal Logic on Finite Traces ($\mathsf{PLTL}_f}$). We impose solution concepts (e.g., Nash equilibrium, subgame-perfect equilibrium) as constraints on the joint strategy profile, using payoffs derived from each agent's probability of satisfying its temporal objective. In particular, we formulate per-agent rational synthesis as finding a strategy profile -- if one exists -- such that (i) the designated agent's probabilistic temporal constraint is satisfied, and (ii) the profile represents a stable solution under a chosen solution concept. We give conditional convergence guarantees for tabular Nash-Q learning, certify satisfaction with simultaneous finite-sample confidence bounds, and assess strategic stability with approximate best-response checking. Our approach operates in a stochastic \emph{Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning} (MARL) environment, where model-free learning algorithms attempt to attain extremal satisfaction probabilities for temporal objectives automatically compiled into reward automata. Our approach is empirically validated using 8 general-sum concurrent stochastic games.

papers.title_en: CocoRNA: Collective RNA Design with Cooperative Multi-agent Reinforcement Learning
papers.authors: Tianmeng Hu, Biao Luo, Ke Li
papers.evidence: 采用合作式多智能体强化学习，但应用于RNA设计而非社会协作。
papers.tldr: RNA逆向设计旨在寻找能折叠成指定二级结构的序列，但设计空间复杂，难以兼顾成功率与速度。CocoRNA将任务拆解为较小子问题，通过合作式多智能体强化学习协同求解，并利用掌握全局结构信息的集中式评价器指导训练。在Rfam数据集上，该方法的成功率和设计速度均显著优于现有先进方法，还能无需额外训练泛化至未见结构。其他生物序列设计实验进一步展示了该框架处理复杂设计任务的潜力。
papers.abstract_en: Designing RNA sequences that reliably fold into specific secondary structures is essential for understanding their biological functions but remains a challenging computational problem. We propose CocoRNA, a cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning framework for RNA inverse design. CocoRNA simplifies the design task by decomposing it into smaller sub-problems, each solved collaboratively by multiple agents. This approach reduces the complexity of the problem and improves the exploration of design policies. During training, a centralized critic uses global structural information to guide the agents, enabling them to jointly optimize their design strategies. As a result, CocoRNA learns high-quality RNA design policies that generalize effectively to unseen structures without additional training. Experiments on the Rfam dataset demonstrate that CocoRNA substantially outperforms state-of-the-art methods in both success rate and design speed. Further experiments on other biological sequence design tasks highlight the effectiveness and broad potential of CocoRNA for complex design tasks.

papers.title_en: From Neglect to Resignation: Understanding the Evolution of Mobile Privacy
papers.authors: Yibo Meng, Ziqi Liu, Lionel Z. Wang, Shuning Zhang, Xiaolan Ding
papers.evidence: 研究用户面对人工智能画像时的隐私无力感
papers.tldr: 移动隐私风险从权限访问扩展到跨平台追踪与人工智能推断，用户理解也随之变化。研究在2014—2023年通过四轮访谈，纵向追踪31名中国智能手机用户。用户经历了从功能导向的权限接受，到因行为追踪反馈而提高警惕，再到面对生态级画像感到无力的三个阶段。研究指出，隐私认命并非固定态度，而是基础设施累积暴露、不断重释早期授权并耗尽自我管理能力的结果，因而需要超越权限控制的系统级保护。
papers.abstract_en: This decade-long longitudinal qualitative study follows 31 smartphone users in China across four interview waves (2014-2023) to examine how mobile privacy understanding evolves alongside shifting computing infrastructures. Findings reveal three stages shaped by distinct interactional mechanisms: early functional acceptance of permission-based data access, growing vigilance triggered by behavioral tracking feedback loops, and eventual resignation as AI-driven inference made ecosystem-level profiling feel inescapable. Rather than a stable attitude, digital resignation emerges through cumulative infrastructure exposure, as each new system layer retroactively reinterpreted earlier permissions and exhausted users' capacity for self-management. The study challenges permission-centric design assumptions and proposes inference visibility, context isolation, and automated privacy agency as system-level responses.

papers.title_en: Neuro-Inspired Inhibitory Message Passing for Accurate and Token-Efficient Multi-Agent Reasoning
papers.authors: Nima H. Siboni, Magdalena Springer, Vahid Rostami
papers.evidence: 提出减少多智能体协作通信冗余的方法
papers.tldr: 多智能体协作中，反复传播的共享信息会挤占上下文，使稀有但决定性的证据被忽视。论文借鉴皮层抑制机制，提出无需训练的消息路由器，按证据句和接收者去重，仅转发对方缺少的证据，不传递发送者的推理与答案。在三个基准上，同级智能体群体的准确率提高39—77个百分点，每次运行的令牌消耗降低10%—46%。效果覆盖多种模型、最多64个智能体及多类组织架构，为兼顾准确性与通信效率提供了可扩展方案。
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent systems promise to solve problems by bringing together information beyond the reach of any individual agent. Retrieval and tool use can distribute this information across agents, making communication essential to collaboration. A central challenge is keeping crucial evidence visible in each agent's context as messages accumulate. Repeated information can crowd out rare, decisive evidence. Models of cortical circuits suggest a principle for addressing this imbalance: inhibition can selectively suppress shared inputs while preserving sensitivity to weaker signals. We adapt this principle into inhibitory message passing, a training-free communication router that cancels redundant evidence separately for each evidence sentence and receiver. Each round, it forwards evidence sentences restated in agents' messages, delivering each at most once to receivers whose own evidence lacks it and excluding the senders' reasoning and answers. Against standard message passing, accuracy in peer groups rose by 39-77 percentage points across three benchmarks, and tokens per run fell by 10-46%. Gains held across seven open models spanning four to thirty-two billion parameters and two commercial models, in groups up to sixty-four agents, and across multi-agent architectures including peer-to-peer, orchestrator-worker, and multilevel hierarchical organizations. These findings support a scalable design pattern for more accurate and token-efficient multi-agent reasoning.

papers.title_en: Measuring Consensus in AI Agent Networks
papers.authors: Jin Gao
papers.evidence: 研究相连智能体之间的沟通与共同决策
papers.tldr: 联网智能体需要协商并共同决策，但意见趋同不等于答案正确。论文提出共识评估框架，结合累积公开交流记录，追踪立场轨迹、群体离散程度与消息中的信息。两个案例覆盖分布式事实下的人员配置，以及重复信息和合同取消的处理；1872次完成运行显示，分享解释与决策更准确相关，但汇总答案准确仍可能伴随持续分歧。框架将群体收敛与接近全信息答案分开衡量，并以成员变动实验补充评估。
papers.abstract_en: As AI agents become increasingly connected through networks and take on tasks that require negotiation and joint decision-making, a systematic approach is needed to assess how their views converge and what information supports their decisions. We present an evaluation framework that treats consensus formation as the evolution of publicly stated positions toward a shared region, using accumulated communication history as context. The framework tracks position trajectories, group dispersion, and information expressed in public messages. Two case studies examine staffing decisions based on distributed facts and decisions requiring agents to reconcile duplicate information and a cancelled contract. Results from 1,872 completed runs associate sharing explanations with more accurate group decisions, while the second task reveals persistent disagreement despite accurate aggregate answers. Membership-change experiments provide a complementary evaluation. By separating convergence among agents from progress toward a task's full-information answer, the framework relates decision accuracy and bounded disagreement to the information available during the exchange.

papers.title_en: RouterWorld: Scaling Conversational AI with Latency-Aware LLM Routing
papers.authors: Jinyang Li, Denis Emelin, Simone Tedeschi, Weiwei Cheng, Cristina Morariu, Haytham Assem, Jens Lehmann, Emine Yilmaz, Angus Addlesee
papers.evidence: 以自然用户交互和多轮智能体轨迹评估对话式人工智能。
papers.tldr: 大模型对话系统需要兼顾回答质量与响应延迟，但现有路由评测常假设能观测所有候选模型的结果，与真实部署不符。RouterWorld整合37.1万条单轮回复和7.6万条多轮智能体轨迹，以统一模型裁判和基于硬件的延迟标注开展评测。它通过冷启动与持续数据流两种设置刻画部分可观测环境，测试13种路由基线，发现多数方法偏重准确率、忽视延迟。该基准为贴近真实部署约束的质量—延迟权衡提供了统一评测基础。
papers.abstract_en: Conversational AI systems built on Large Language Models (LLMs) require routing mechanisms that balance answer quality and response latency at scale. However, existing LLM routing benchmarks assume full observability of all candidate model outcomes, under-emphasize latency as a first-class metric, and fragment evaluation across heterogeneous protocols misaligned with real-world settings. We introduce RouterWorld, a comprehensive benchmark for LLM routing in conversational GenAI. RouterWorld unifies 371k single-turn responses and 76k multi-turn agentic trajectories, adopts natural user interactions with a standardized LLM-as-a-judge protocol, and decouples efficiency from transient pricing via hardware-grounded latency annotations. Crucially, RouterWorld formalizes routing under partial observability through two setups: Cold-Start, which restricts learning to sparse, static logs, and Voyager, which models continuous data streams where routing decisions shape future training distributions. Evaluating 13 routing baselines, we find that most routers over-emphasize accuracy while ignoring latency under partial observability. Code and benchmark data are publicly available.

papers.title_en: Tandem: Serving Hybrid Linear-Attention GUI Agents on Mobile NPUs
papers.authors: Zhuomin Chen, Jingchao Ni, Xu Zheng, Yong Chen, Mo Sha, Wei Cheng, Dongsheng Luo
papers.evidence: 研究能读取手机屏幕并执行应用任务的图形界面智能体。
papers.tldr: 手机端GUI智能体需反复推理，混合线性注意力虽节省内存，但提示改写、推测解码回滚和待机耗电削弱了收益。Tandem在相邻提示分叉处保存循环状态，让大部分预填充留在NPU矩阵单元，并优化验证内核与空闲电源管理。在骁龙8 Elite上，相比llama.cpp最快NPU配置，文本与截图步骤延迟分别降低30%和16%，文本步骤能耗降低33%。该系统展示了面向智能体负载协同优化状态复用、计算和电源管理的价值。
papers.abstract_en: Smartphone GUI agents complete tasks in mobile apps by repeatedly reading the screen and asking a model for the next action. Mobile neural processing units (NPUs) enable local execution, keeping screen contents on the phone, but model latency accumulates with every action. Hybrid linear attention models reduce memory requirements, yet reusing their recurrent state requires checkpoints at the appropriate input positions. Agent requests retain instructions but rewrite recent history, so checkpoint policies designed for chat continuation can miss reusable prefixes. Retaining rollback states for speculative decoding can also move prompt processing off the NPU's matrix unit, adding overhead that outweighs decoding savings on short action outputs. A loaded model can further hold the NPU awake between tasks. We present Tandem, a runtime for hybrid GUI agents on mobile NPUs. Tandem saves recurrent state where consecutive prompts diverge, allowing later requests to reuse previously processed context. It keeps most prefill on the matrix unit and produces rollback states through a short per-token tail. Its verification kernel reads each weight block once for all proposed tokens. Between request bursts, Tandem releases NPU power votes without unloading the model. We implement Tandem in llama.cpp and evaluate it on recorded agent interactions across two Snapdragon generations. On a Snapdragon 8 Elite, Tandem reduces per-step latency by 30% for text-based screen descriptions and 16% for screenshots relative to llama.cpp's fastest NPU configuration, reduces energy per text step by 33%, and lowers standby power with the model loaded from 0.76 to 0.22 W.

papers.title_en: The Culture Within: Towards Mechanistic Understanding of Cultural Reasoning in LLMs
papers.authors: Samee Arif, Furkan Danisman, Angana Borah, Honglak Lee, Dehan Kong, Lajanugen Logeswaran, Moontae Lee, Zhijing Jin, Rada Mihalcea
papers.evidence: 研究大语言模型的文化推理能否遵循明确给出的社会规范与价值。
papers.tldr: 大语言模型虽掌握文化知识，却可能在冲突信息面前偏离当地规范。研究构建覆盖75国、9261个场景的文化评测基准，并结合模型内部干预，区分知识缺失与知识被覆盖。三个模型在错误规范提示下的文化对齐回答率下降32—47个百分点，屏蔽该规范后多数可恢复正确回答。使用冲突规范样本微调后，对齐率升至85%—93%，且能泛化至未见国家，揭示了文化推理的脆弱性及可行改进方向。
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly operate across culturally diverse settings, yet existing evaluations largely measure cultural behavior at the output level. We introduce CultureLens, a reference-grounded benchmark and mechanistic study of how LLMs use cultural information. CultureLens contains 9,261 scenarios across 75 countries and systematically varies country, value, true-norm, and contradictory-norm evidence. Across Llama-3.1-8B, Gemma-3-12B, and Qwen-3.5-27B, stating a contradictory norm lowers aligned answers by 32-47 percentage points, even when the model answers correctly from the country alone. Mechanistically, models default to Anglophone norms when no country is given. The failure under a contradictory norm is not one of missing knowledge, as blocking the norm inside the model restores the correct answer in most cases. Models accept a stated norm according to how it is presented and not whether it is true, which leaves them most exposed to errors in retrieved content. Supervised fine-tuning with contradictory-norm examples raises aligned answers under a contradictory norm to 85-93%, including on unseen countries, at a small cost under a true norm.

papers.title_en: From Encoding to Generation: Towards Empathetic Large Language Models
papers.authors: Samhita Bollepally, Takashi Yamauchi, Marissa West
papers.evidence: 研究语言模型如何理解用户情绪并生成共情对话回应
papers.tldr: 语言模型能识别用户情绪，却未必在回复中恰当回应。研究以认知与情感共情为框架，对Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct的十类情绪开展逐层探测、注意力分析和生成对齐测量。中层情绪分类准确率达63.6%，情绪词获得1.89倍注意力，但回复与目标情绪的平均相似度由0.239降至0.125。结果揭示情绪编码、关注与回应之间的差异，为监测生成中的情绪信息提供依据。
papers.abstract_en: Empathetic interaction involves two distinguishable capacities: representing another person's emotional state (cognitive empathy) and generating an appropriate response to that state (affective empathy). We apply this distinction to examine how emotion-related information is internally organized, selectively attended to, and carried through response generation in Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct across 10 emotion categories from the EmpatheticDialogues dataset. Layer-wise linear probing revealed a broad middle-layer region of peak emotion-category decodability, with the layer-11 L2 probe achieving 63.6% held-out accuracy against a 10% chance level and a 54.6% TF-IDF lexical baseline. During response generation, emotion-related user tokens received 1.89 times as much attention per token as other utterance tokens, concentrated across layers 10-15. Target-emotion alignment then decreased from a mean cosine similarity of 0.239 for input representations to 0.125 for generated responses, with positive drift in 77% of examples and the largest shifts for angry and furious. Emotion-category representation, attention allocation, and response-level alignment therefore emerge as distinguishable components of model processing that can be analyzed through a functional cognitive-affective empathy framework. These findings provide a foundation for monitoring emotion representations during generation and leveraging models' existing affective structure to support more naturally empathetic responses without relying on external prompting or explicit emotion conditioning.
